newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine grain harvest lags at 21.08 mln T - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine grain harvest lags at 21.08 mln T - ministry.

text.p: Ukraine has harvested nearly 21.08 million tonnes of grain so far this year, well below the 28.99 million tonnes cut by this time last year, the statistics ministry said on Thursday.
Crop yields were lower at 2.10 tonnes per hectare compared to 2.60 tonnes at the same time last year.
The ministry gave the following data on harvest progress,
According to the ministry, winter wheat harvest so far is 13.15 million tonnes.
Yields were 2.24 tonnes per hectare against 3.20 tonnes at the same point last year.
Ukraine had also harvested 4.79 million tonnes of barley, compared to 8.99 million tonnes, and 1.0 million tonnes of rye, down from 1.18 million tonnes, both in 1995.
Deputy Prime Minister Mykhailo Zubets said last month that the total 1996 grain harvest would be about 28 million tonnes, down from 1995's 36.5 million tonnes.
The government has also forecast a winter wheat harvest of 14 million tonnes, compared to 16.4 million tonnes in 1995.
Government officials predicted Ukrainian grain exports to neighbouring countries this year would rise to three million tonnes. --Yuri Kulikov, Kiev newsroom, +380 44 229 2264
